title: Roles
subtitle: Define what each role can see and do.

dialog.title: Permissions for {{role}}
dialog.description: Changes apply the next time the affected users load the app.

refreshHint: Re-authenticate to see the new permissions in your own session.
readOnly: You can view roles, but not change their permissions.

permissionItems.dashboardReadDescription: Access the dashboard, KPIs and charts.
permissionItems.userReadDescription: Browse the user list and open user details.
permissionItems.userCreateDescription: Invite new members to the workspace.
permissionItems.userUpdateDescription: Edit user profiles, roles and status.
permissionItems.userDeleteDescription: Permanently remove members from the workspace.
permissionItems.roleReadDescription: See roles and the permissions attached to them.
permissionItems.roleUpdateDescription: Change the permission set of a role.
permissionItems.demoResetDescription: Restore the demo workspace to its seeded state.

descriptions.admin: Full access to every feature in the workspace.
descriptions.manager: Manages people and roles, but cannot delete users.
descriptions.viewer: Read-only access for reporting and audits.

saveNote: Permissions are checked on navigation and on every write request.
